# ankra_ai_lanes (Data Source)

Lists every AI lane with the model it runs on. The counterpart of `ankra ai lanes list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_ai_lanes" "all" {}

output "lane_models" {
  value = { for lane in data.ankra_ai_lanes.all.lanes : lane.lane => lane.effective_model_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `lanes` (Attributes List) AI lanes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lanes))

<a id="nestedatt--lanes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lanes`

Read-Only:

- `default_tier` (String) Tier the lane runs on without a selection.
- `description` (String) What the lane does.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `effective_model_id` (String) Model id the lane runs on now.
- `effective_model_name` (String) Display name of that model.
- `is_selection_stale` (Boolean) Whether the selection no longer resolves.
- `lane` (String) Lane name, the `lane` of `ankra_ai_lane_model`.
- `selected_model_key` (String) The organisation's selection; null when the lane follows its default.
